notebooklm_extracted_chunks.principle: Acknowledge the concern before proposing a small, optional next step.
notebooklm_extracted_chunks.application: Use when a prospect raises price, effort, or timing resistance but has not asked to stop the call.
notebooklm_extracted_chunks.when_not_to_use: Do not use after do-not-call, hangup, human request, legal, medical, coverage, or sensitive-data boundaries.

example_phrases.en: That makes sense. No changes needed today; we can simply check whether a short review is useful.
example_phrases.de: Das verstehe ich. Heute muss nichts geaendert werden; wir pruefen nur kurz, ob ein kurzer Blick sinnvoll ist.

notebooklm_extracted_chunks.compliance_notes: Keep the next step optional. Do not promise savings, outcomes, coverage, or guaranteed value.
notebooklm_extracted_chunks.citation_note: Synthetic demo chunk for RAG-001 schema validation; replace with NotebookLM source-tracked extraction.

notebooklm_extracted_chunks.principle: Choose wording that naturally points emphasis toward the meaning instead of relying on artificial stress tags.
notebooklm_extracted_chunks.application: Use before provider TTS when a sentence contains weak stress targets such as you, anything, today, or change.
notebooklm_extracted_chunks.when_not_to_use: Do not rewrite campaign-required questions, disclosures, handoff text, do-not-call language, or regulated claims.

example_phrases.en: No changes needed today; we can simply check whether it is worth a short review.

notebooklm_extracted_chunks.compliance_notes: Voice naturalness must not add pressure, false urgency, or claims beyond the campaign profile.
